SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Card. m.]
Pressure in stomach : with eructation of air ; at night awakening ; lasting all day ; coming and disappearing during day.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Card. m.]
The diseased liver has either already implicated the lungs, showing itself by hæmoptysis, as in simple congestion, or as inflammation of liver and lungs ; vomiting of blood.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Card. m.]
Sensation of motion in intestines on expiration, extending breadth of a hand around umbilicus.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Card. m.]
Stool very hard and insufficient.
   

COUGH. [27] [Card. m.]
Cough with stitches in sides of chest, and bloody sputa. θ Epidemic affection.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Card. m.]
Pains in chest going to front part, to shoulders, back, loins and abdomen, combined with urging to urinate. θ Epidemic affection.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Card. m.]
Drawing pains in entire back, followed by fatigue.
Drawing pain on right side of back, from shoulder blade to lumbar region, changing locality.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Card. m.]
Drawing pain in muscles covering left radius, alternating with pain in same muscles of right side.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Card. m.]
Pain in hip joints, spreading through buttocks, causing difficulty in arising, < from stooping.
   

FEVER. [40] [Card. m.]
Epidemic affection (See Chest and Stomach), lasting seven weeks, was lessened to a few days ; the longest seven days.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Card. m.]
Dropsical diseases, depending on organic affections of the liver ; frequently of long standing.
